name: Retrieval Beyond Documents (RBD)
overview: RBD studies how language agents retrieve capabilities such as tools, skills, workflows, memory, models, and other agents. Its scope covers capability representation and indexing, retrieval and composition, adaptation during execution, evaluation of capability use, and deployment in dynamic registries.

name: GRAIL-V: Grounded Retrieval and Agentic Intelligence for Vision-Language
overview: GRAIL-V brings together research on grounded multimodal retrieval, reranking, reasoning, and verification. The workshop connects agent planning and tool use with evidence selection, citation provenance, and benchmark design for vision-language systems.

name: DocInsights: Workshop on Document Intelligence and Understanding
overview: DocInsights studies document intelligence across text, layout, tables, figures, and relationships within and across documents. Its scope includes evidence-grounded reasoning, multimodal understanding, retrieval, evaluation, robustness, and deployment. Shared tasks address quantitative document reasoning and expert-level document parsing.
